Name: English lamp posts - OUTDATED
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: This is a texture mod that replaces the default lamp posts on your farm.
Description:
Hi all, Minerva here!  This mod will hopefully be updated sometime soon so you can continue to enjoy it <3  It will be moving to Moddrop as well, for better moderation of asset use.

WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS OR MODDROP. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE.
__________

I should have a JA version of this up fairly soon for you all to enjoy!

This mod replaces the default lamp posts on your farm. I've always liked English style looking lamp posts, so I made them.
I thought it was fun to make two versions: a clean one and a 'dirty' one with moss hanging from it to give it an old feeling.

These were intentionally made to match my other mods ([medieval buildings](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/419/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D419&pUp=1), [medieval map](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/466/?tab=3&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodimages%2F%3Fuser%3D0%26id%3D466%26gid%3D1303), [medieval wall stuff](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/470/?tab=4&&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fcomments%2F%3Fmod_id%3D470%26page%3D1%26sort%3DDESC%26pid%3D0%26thread_id%3D4616705&pUp=1)), but if you want to use these without my other mods, you totally can!

How to install:
put the craftables.xnb in TileSheets. Let it overwrite the default craftables.xnb, but be sure to make a back up first!

I hope these will all give you a magical feeling.

Also, do you like my lamp posts but you're already using another craftables.xnb that a modder made? You can combine them! I've added the png file so you can grab my lamp posts and put them in your desired file. Read [this thread](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/modding-guides-and-general-modding-discussion-redux.109131/) with guides on how to do that.
